DeCode: Decoupling Content and Delivery for Medical QA [1] is the paper that matches this query. It proposes a training-free, model-agnostic framework that decouples content and delivery to adapt existing LLMs for contextualized clinical answers, and it reports improved medical question answering performance [1].

If you want related but different approaches, one paper uses retrieval-augmented generation and fine-tuning to ground answers in medical literature [2], while another uses multi-source retrieval and in-context learning for direct and sequential biomedical questions [3].
